description: React component for an Activity page that fetches, displays, and updates recent activity data with real-time updates via WebSocket. It includes data fetching, socket subscription, pagination, and rendering of a data table with status indicators.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches activity data from API and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: normalizeRealtime
methods.description: Normalizes incoming WebSocket payload into a consistent feed item structure.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Advances to the next page in pagination.

methods.name: prevPage
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page in pagination.
